page.content:
Marine geologist who published Tharp's physiographic maps of the ocean floor.

How Bruce Heezen connects

  • Character: Marie Tharp — Heezen collected the soundings Tharp assembled into seafloor maps.
  • Faction: Lamont–Doherty Earth Observatory — Heezen was a Lamont marine geologist.

What is Bruce Heezen?

Bruce Heezen collected echo-sounding profiles that Tharp assembled; together they showed the global mid-ocean ridge as a single mountain chain.

Key threads lead to Marie Tharp and Lamont–Doherty Earth Observatory.
